d:
Celebrate the festive spirit with “Bappa”, the ultimate high-energy track that will make you want to get up and dance! Sung by the powerful Vishal Dadlani, composed by the sensational duo Vishal & Shekhar, and penned by the talented Amitabh Bhattacharya, this song is packed with infectious beats, vibrant energy, and a celebration of joy that will instantly lift your mood.
Whether you’re dancing at a party, celebrating with friends, or just need a dose of musical energy, “Bappa” is your go-to track! Don’t just listen — feel the vibe, sing along, and let the music take over.
Song: Bappa
